Simulate log-normal single-cell counts

Source: R/simulate_pseudo_bulk_samples.R
dot-simulate_lognormal_cells.Rd

Draws n_cells count vectors from per-gene log-normal models, optionally scaled by a barcode library factor.

Usage

.simulate_lognormal_cells(bio_params, tech_scale, n_cells, seed = NULL)

Arguments

bio_params

List from .infer_lognormal_gene_params().

tech_scale

Barcode library-size scaling factor.

n_cells

Number of cells to simulate.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

Numeric matrix (genes x cells).

Details

For each cell \(c\) and gene \(g\): $$z_{gc} \sim \mathcal{N}(\hat{\mu}_g, \hat{\sigma}_g^2), \quad x_{gc} = \max\left\{0, \left\lfloor e^{z_{gc}} \cdot s_b - 1 \right\rfloor \right\}$$
